sources.entry: Pacer by EricAndrechek - Native macOS app for tracking Claude Code usage — tokens, cost, rate-limit pacing, per-project breakdowns. SwiftUI + SwiftData.

summary.one_liner: Pacer is a free, open-source native macOS menu-bar app that tracks Claude Code token usage, cost, and rate-limit pacing on your own Mac.
summary.what_it_does: Pacer reads Claude Code's local session logs (~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl) and polls Anthropic's usage API with the Claude Code login token to show your 5-hour, weekly, and per-model rate-limit windows as pace charts with forecasts and color bands. It shows spend either as Claude Code reports it or priced from tokens, with daily, monthly, and all-time totals and a live "today" burn projection. Usage can be broken down by project (grouped into non-destructive collections), by model, and by day, with a six-month activity heatmap. It supports multiple Claude accounts, a configurable menu-bar readout, home-screen and Notification Center widgets, optional threshold and daily-budget notifications, CSV export, and a `pacer` command-line tool. It also ships a Claude Code skill that lets agents check limits before large fan-outs.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code token usage and cost
check how close I am to my Claude rate limits
track Claude spending by project or model
export Claude usage to CSV for spreadsheets
pace long-running Claude Code agent runs against limits
how_to_run: Download the Pacer-x.y.z.dmg from the latest GitHub release and drag Pacer into Applications
Launch Pacer and click Allow when macOS asks to read Claude Code's files
Or install with Homebrew: brew install --cask ericandrechek/tap/pacer
For building from source: install xcodegen with brew install xcodegen
Run make verify (unsigned compile check) or make test (PacerCore tests)
make install builds a signed and notarized app, which requires your own Apple Developer account
notable: Reads Anthropic's actual rate-limit percentages rather than estimating from local logs
Per-model (scoped) rate-limit windows with pacing against an ideal-burn line
Multi-account attribution with a toolbar menu to scope the whole app
Local-first: only network calls are to api.anthropic.com and github.com for updates
Includes a Claude Code skill and a pacer CLI for agents and scripts
caveats: Pre-1.0 and under active development; saved history may need rebuilding between 0.x versions
Requires macOS 15 (Sequoia) or newer; no Windows or Linux support
Building a runnable app from source needs your own Apple Developer account
keywords: see how close i am to my limit
